shared: Use case: identity-preserve. Production enemy SPRITE ATLAS for Crossroads Realms Beyond. First image is existing design reference, one creature per labelled row; ignore the labels themselves. Image2 is required matte coarse pixel-art style reference ONLY. Match soft coloured edges, matte shading and neutral poses of V207/V208. Polish the actual designs, no generic humanoid replacements. Thin selective muted coloured contours, restrained midtones, square pixel clusters; NO thick black sticker outlines, white rims, glossy bevels, surrounding glow or high-detail illustration. Exactly FOUR columns. In each row draw SAME ONE enemy in four poses: IDLE, MOVE A, MOVE B, ATTACK. Same front-facing head/torso and equipment side in every pose. No side lunge, no projectile flying out one side; attack effect compact at body. Movement A/B alternate feet or legs; flying creatures use wing/body changes, plants sway/root-step, objects flex. Same body size/head position and foot or hover baseline per row. Do NOT add shadows, labels, text, scenery, row dividers, frames or floor. Genuine transparent background with generous clear gutters, all cells separated. Designed for64x64 runtime frames, keep simple readable material shading and silhouette. Canvas portrait large enough for each row.

honeyglass.desc: Honeyglass Gardens, amber conservatory. Exactly FIVE rows. Row1 Queen Mellifera / glass_queen: golden striped BEE QUEEN, rounded compact insect body, small gold crown, warm cream bee face, two broad pale aqua glassy wings, NOT a human queen, 6 tiny insect limbs; idle hovering, wingA/wingB, attack crown/sting raised with tiny amber motes. Row2 Honey Beetle: orange/amber oval beetle shell divided down centre, four pale honey flecks, brown head, six little brown legs and short antennae. Two alternating sets of insect legs, attack shell opens slightly. Row3 Seed Blossom: five broad soft pink petals, golden seed-pod centre with dark little mouth, green stem/leaves and tiny rootfeet; sway petals and roots for movement, attack pod opens at centre. Row4 Amber Hornet: angular gold/brown striped hornet with pointed russet stinger and TWO narrower aqua wings, antennae, small insect limbs; more sharp wasp anatomy than round queen, wings alternate, attack stinger tucked/braced. Row5 Royal Nectar Nurse: small rounded honeybee with pale wings, gentle dark eyes, green healing pouch with simple pale plus mark on viewer RIGHT; small antennae, gold/brown abdomen; hover wingA/B, attack cups tiny green nectar at pouch. Keep all five visibly different and true to originals.

elementary.desc: Firstbell Elementary whimsical possessed school supplies. Exactly SIX rows. Row1 The Last Bus / yellow_bus: broad yellow SCHOOL BUS with blue windows, black/grey trim, two visible dark wheels, folding door and roof sign without text. Preserve reference SIDE ELEVATION and wide body, do not turn it front-on. Movement rotates wheel marks/compresses suspension subtly, neutral attack has opening door and small amber headlights. Row2 Pencil Scrapper: tall yellow wooden pencil with pink eraser, metal ferrule, graphite pointed tip, tiny dark face and two twiglike arms/feet; angled pencil identity, no human child body. Movement little alternating feet, attack braces graphite tip close. Row3 Backpack Biter: slate blue rectangular backpack MONSTER with top loop, two cream eyes, jagged zipper-mouth teeth and tiny strap feet. Alternate strap feet, attack mouth opens, not humanoid backpack wearer. Row4 Paper Sprite: ivory folded paper diamond/airplane spirit with slate creases and two dark eyes near centre. Hover creases flex A/B, attack curls paper tips inward around tiny chalk spark. Row5 Lesson Warden: ambulatory upright golden OPEN BOOK with brown binding, two small square eyes/page chevrons, dark blue flat cap and boots, brown simple arms. Alternate book feet, attack pages opened slightly with contained gold flick. Row6 Recess Ringleader: a grinning golden PLAYGROUND BALL inside a sturdy dark slate blue circular hoop/frame with two teal upright side rails. Not a human. Move rocks ring gently in place, alternate rail/foot supports, attack central ball braces and ring tightens with small chalk sparks. Preserve original individual silhouettes, richer but simple matte material shading. No people dressed as school supplies.

sunfield.desc: Sunfield Expanse golden meadow. Exactly THREE rows. Row1 Sun Sentinel: floating round PLUM/PURPLE SUN SEED face with two pale ivory eyes, muted gold rim and pointed warm ivory/golden solar flare on top, little dark base. Not a humanoid. Idle and movement small shifting flame/solar crown shapes, attack contained radial gold rays near rim. Row2 Solstice Cantor / sunbeam_cantor: quiet faceless warm brown head under a golden radiant ring of eight narrow sun rays; simple saffron/gold bell-shaped robe, slim dark staff with cream circular sun orb on viewer RIGHT. Robe hem movement A/B without hopping head; attack staff raised with compact warm sun motes. Row3 Saffron Hopper: actual meadow GRASSHOPPER, olive-green segmented insect body with saffron golden dorsal stripe, antennae, long bent hind legs and little forelegs. Front-facing or shallow3/4 neutral insect anatomy, no clothes. Move alternates small insect steps with bent jump-ready legs, attack gathered leap-prep crouch. Preserve creature identity and unique silhouette; no duplicates or generic round blobs.

ice.desc: Frostbound Rink frosty blue creatures. Exactly FIVE rows. Row1 Frostling: small faceted icy-blue pointed CRYSTAL creature, two tiny dark square eyes, two short dark blue feet; asymmetrical frost tips, frozen matte facets with restrained shades. Alternate tiny feet, attack little frost shards held near body. Row2 Ice Archer: compact icy-blue hooded archer with shadowed dark blue face and small pale eyes, white icy bow on viewer RIGHT, blue robe and boots; alternate feet, attack bow pulled at centre front with NO arrow flying to one side. Row3 Glacier Hound: quadrupedal icy pale blue DOG/WOLF with long muzzle, triangular ears, four dark blue paws, three glacial crystals on back. Keep clearly canine, no human torso/outfit. Neutral front/shallow3/4 view same in all poses, paws alternate, attack jaw opens with contained cold breath near mouth. Row4 Snow Oracle: hovering pale blue cloaked snowy spirit, golden circular face/eye inside pale icy face aperture, thin pale aqua ring halo above, ragged icy cloak hem. Hood/face front-facing, hover hem/hand changes A/B, attack cups tiny frost orb near torso. Row5 Cryowarden BOSS: broad stocky horned glacial ARMOUR GOLEM, icy blue jagged shoulders, square dark inset visor, blue segmented torso, thick dark blue legs, white ice blade on viewer RIGHT, no human skin. Strong distinct large boss shape, alternate heavy steps with stable torso; attack blade braced near chest with compact frost chips. Preserve all original silhouettes, matte snow and crystal shading.

confluence.desc: Confluence Foundry water-and-lightning industrial guardians. Exactly FOUR rows. Row1 The Divided Heart / confluence_heart BOSS: floating circular bronze machine ring, four broad bronze mounting tabs top/bottom/sides, core vertically split AQUA WATER on viewer LEFT and AMBER LIGHTNING on viewer RIGHT, pale central dividing spindle. Not human/biological heart. Same circle in all frames; subtle moving core ripples/coils A/B, attack core opens with small contained water/spark motes. Row2 Sluice Crab: low broad teal BRONZE mechanical CRAB, broad teal box-shaped carapace, two raised pale brass eye stalks, two large ochre claws and multiple short articulated legs. Alternate mechanical crab legs, attack both claws close at centre, no person in armour. Row3 Coil Singer: upright brass TESLA COIL creature, three horizontal brass coil bars around narrow neck, small round golden top with tiny dark eyes, tapering dark slate pedestal. No human limbs/head. Move flexes coil spacing/oscillates tabs while base consistent, attack small contained spark between coil bars. Row4 Glass Mender: floating diamond/kite-shaped faceted AQUA GLASS spirit with dark navy rim, bright ivory vertical heart seam, two tiny dark eyes and small brass side tabs/hands. Same compact abstract shape each pose, A/B flex tabs/facets, attack cups tiny mending shard at centre. Keep hardware, water and glass distinct, no glossy bevel/high contrast black border.

hound_correction: Separate four-pose 2x2 sheet; front-facing icy quadrupedal wolf, both eyes visible, alternating four paws, glacial crest and dark blue feet retained. No side profile or humanoid body.
